title: Learn How to Shuffle - In Only 5 Minutes - for Beginners

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down foundational steps into small components and builds them up step-by-step. He uses verbal cues and counts while demonstrating from a front-facing viewpoint.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to learning how to shuffle in 5 minutes.
Explaining the floor markers for foot placement.
Breaking down the running man step.
Explaining 4/4 time and splitting counts into eight pieces with 'and'.
Practicing the steps with music at increasing speed.
Follow along full demonstration to music.

steps_taught.name: Running Man
steps_taught.description: Hop and slide foot work with alternating knees coming up.

what_works: Breaking down the count into 'and' increments

quotes.text: I'm going to teach you guys how to shuffle.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing camera talking and introducing the tutorial.
Teacher demonstrates foot and knee lifts for the running man step.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using physical markers on the floor to designate front, center, and back positions for foot alignment.
